# Complete rooms, atmosphere and relighting

Preserve camera, furnishing and one coherent light field across room and figure. An illustrated setting remains fictional and supplies no navigation geometry.

These complete design briefs draw on recorded material; the records identify independent specifications separately. Read the [collection guide](../retained-generation-requests.md) before interpreting a historical request. A statement of approval inside a body describes its recorded context; it is not present authorization. No input is attached to this text. Only a current resource record can establish what may be used. Illustrative scenes, text and numbers are design content, not user history or a model/tool receipt.

Read, in order: [room-and-identity.md](../../../../docs/materials/visual/prompt-collections/room-and-identity.md); [FRONTEND_DESIGN.md](../../../../FRONTEND_DESIGN.md); [CHARACTER_MOTION_PIPELINE.md](../../../../docs/design/CHARACTER_MOTION_PIPELINE.md).

Use with work-order blocks [06-A](../../../../docs/development/work-orders/05-08.md), [06-C](../../../../docs/development/work-orders/05-08.md), [07-A](../../../../docs/development/work-orders/05-08.md), and [work sequence](../../../../docs/development/WORK_SEQUENCE.md). Use the sequence to place this material within the larger work.
